evidence.billAExcerpt: tisk 4, .data/law-collision-cache/tisk-4/265053.txt lines 8-17 (§35ba odst.1): 'a) základní slevu ve výši 30 840 Kč na poplatníka, / a) základní slevu na poplatníka ve výši odpovídající 75 % průměrné hrubé měsíční nominální mzdy přepočtené na plně zaměstnané ... b) slevu na manžela, c) základní slevu na invaliditu ... d) rozšířenou slevu na invaliditu ... e) slevu na držitele průkazu ZTP/P' -- tisk 4 REPLACES only the amount/formula of item a) (fixed 30,840 Kč -> 75%-of-average-wage formula) and leaves b), c), d), e) untouched at their existing letters. Corroborating: tisk 4's §35c(1) stays a single unlettered paragraph, only the child-benefit amounts are changed (15204->22320 Kč etc.), lines 59-67.
evidence.billBExcerpt: tisk 120, .data/law-collision-cache/tisk-120/268223.txt lines 11-31 (§35ba odst.1): 'a) základní slevu ve výši 30 840 Kč na poplatníka, / b)a) slevu na manžela, / c)b) základní slevu na invaliditu ... / d)c) rozšířenou slevu na invaliditu ... / e)d) slevu na držitele průkazu ZTP/P'. Tisk 120 REMOVES the basic relief from §35ba(1)(a) altogether -- it relocates it to a brand-new §35c(1)(a) 'na poplatníka ve výši 30 840 Kč ročně' (line 55) -- and renumbers all remaining §35ba(1) letters down by one (b->a, c->b, d->c, e->d). Corroborating: tisk 120's §35c(1) is explicitly split into new a)/b) (lines 53-57), unlike tisk 4's unlettered single paragraph.

reasoning: Both bills amend §35ba(1) of 586/1992 with mutually incompatible assumptions about what letter 'a)' means after their own change. Tisk 4 keeps 'a)' as the basic per-taxpayer relief (just changes its formula from a flat 30,840 Kč to 75% of average wage) and leaves b)-e) as-is. Tisk 120 deletes the basic-relief item from §35ba(1) entirely (moving it to a new §35c(1)(a)) and shifts every remaining letter down by one, so its 'a)' becomes 'sleva na manžela' (spousal relief) -- a completely different substantive meaning at the same letter. If both were enacted, a court/drafter would face two irreconcilable pictures of §35ba(1)(a): a wage-linked basic relief (tisk 4) vs. a spousal relief that used to be 'b)' (tisk 120). This is structurally the same failure mode as the already-confirmed 120<->244 collision (both amend §35ba assuming different starting letterings), and it is corroborated independently by the parallel, equally incompatible restructuring of §35c(1) between the two bills (unlettered single paragraph in tisk 4 vs. a)/b) split in tisk 120).
